runtime.cuda_default_path_observation: /usr/local/cuda is a directory with CUDA libraries but does not expose bin/nvcc; future builds must set CUDA_HOME/PATH explicitly after environment approval

python_environment_gap.implication: A task-owned isolated environment on NVMe is required before Wall-X reference/export or CUDAExtension build; no package installation was attempted in Phase 0.

hf_cli.installation: Homebrew on macOS; command surface lacks the newer hf models subcommand, so Hub REST metadata was used instead of upgrading the CLI

target_build_requirement: TensorRT engine and any CUDAExtension must be built on agx-test with the target Jetson software contract, not on the Mac.
